name: com.foreverworks/anaf-spv
title: ANAF SPV
description: MCP server for ANAF's Spațiul Privat Virtual (pfinternet.anaf.ro)

environmentVariables.name: ANAF_SPV_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Your SPV user name, when the password comes from a file.

environmentVariables.name: ANAF_SPV_PASSWORD_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of a file holding your SPV password. The README also shows how to read it from a vault MCP server instead.

environmentVariables.name: ANAF_SPV_MAIL_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: A mail MCP server over Streamable HTTP that reads the mailbox SPV sends its codes to, so a sign-in reads the code by itself. Without one (or a command below), every sign-in asks you for the code.

environmentVariables.name: ANAF_SPV_MAIL_MCP_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of a file holding that mail server's bearer token, if it wants one.

environmentVariables.name: ANAF_SPV_MAIL_MCP_COMMAND
environmentVariables.description: Instead of a URL: a mail MCP server to start over stdio, as a JSON array such as ["npx","-y","some-mail-mcp"].
